title: Evaluating Monitor Coverage of OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications

original_idea.body:
# Evaluating Monitor Coverage of OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications

**Problem:** OWASP has published a Top 10 for LLM applications covering prompt injection, insecure output handling, training data poisoning, etc. Whether current agent monitoring tools cover these threats is unknown.

**Direction:** Take each OWASP LLM Top 10 threat category. Test whether a standard agent monitoring stack provides detection coverage for each category. Produce a coverage gap analysis and prioritized improvement list.

**Why it matters:** OWASP Top 10 is a widely adopted security standard. Mapping monitoring coverage to it gives organizations a compliance-aligned view of their monitoring gaps.

**Relevant context:** OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications; agent monitoring tooling; security compliance.
